definition.name: Two observed collections with both Java continuations retaining roots

steps.name: Fetch the immutable native producer source without rebuilding
Install the maintained exact compiler tools and focused controller checks
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_java_checkpoint_gc \
  tools.tests.test_java_checkpoint_gc_fault_frames -v
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --max-time 180 \
  https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-9.1.0-bin.zip -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip"
echo "a17ddd85a26b6a7f5ddb71ff8b05fc5104c0202c6e64782429790c933686c806  $RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" | sha256sum --check --strict
unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle-9.1.0/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
timeout --signal=KILL 180s curl --fail --location \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 1 --max-time 60 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
echo "87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171  $RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-bindgen"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Authenticate the five existing 193-control native products
Build one authenticated bounded numeric diagnostic node
steps.run:
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/java-gc-host-target"
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --lib \
  --features java-checkpoint-gc-trap-diagnostic \
  java_checkpoint_gc_fault::tests::java_gc_fault_visits_only_eight_numeric_frames_for_authenticated_profile \
  -- --exact --test-threads=1
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml build --release --locked -p latentd --bin latentd \
  --features java-checkpoint-gc-trap-diagnostic
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml build --release --locked -p latent --bin latent
